pattern.description: Screen-recorded tree view: the user clicks the Actuals and then the Pre-Elimination toggles. Child rows appear in two steps, and every row below snaps down to make room in both the name and description columns.
pattern.why_premium: This is functional UI rather than designed motion. The framed browser on a brand backdrop and the steady cursor make the hierarchy easy to follow. Rows jump with no height easing, so a recreated version would gain from an eased accordion.

build_hint.gsap: Accordion: tl.fromTo('.child-rows', {height: 0, autoAlpha: 0}, {height: 'auto', autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out'}). Rows below follow automatically, or use a Flip (Flip.from(state, {duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out'})). Run a second level 0.2s later with a 0.03 stagger on the new rows.
build_hint.remotion: Run spring({frame: frame - expandFrame, fps, config: {damping: 200}}) as 0..1 progress. Set child container height = progress * rowCount * rowH and opacity = progress. Offset the rows below by the same height and start the second expansion about 6 frames later.

notes: The source is a step expansion in two clicks (Actuals, then Pre-Elimination) over about 0.4s. The text field of b02 gives only the first new row. The cursor uses a manual box.
